title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1982-08-08
source: Source: (FOB) Beyer M160's > Sony TC-D5M > Cassette Master (TDK MA90) - Taped by Frank Streeter; Transfer: Cassette Master >Nakamichi CR-7A > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) > KORG AudioGate 4 > wav 24/96 - Transferred by Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > Adobe Audition 3 > Celemony Capstan > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 24

ai_review.summary: Recording suffers from tape warp and electrical problems during Loser, making it largely unlistenable.
ai_review.review: The sole review flags a serious technical flaw – an apparent power/electrical issue that caused tape warping on the Loser track. No comments are made about the musical performance, so the show quality cannot be judged from this feedback.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one low‑star review mentioning a major recording defect; no information on performance to boost rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Electrical/power problem causing tape warp during Loser; overall sound likely distorted and unreliable.
